message:
Fixed: the yen receipt now renders as `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass.

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. I added a small zero-decimal currency list containing JPY. Those currencies now print the amount as it is, with no division and no decimals.

`formatMoney` is shared by invoices, cart and admin, so any yen amount shown there changes too. Nothing else in the repo uses JPY, so I found no other caller affected.
